newsitem.title: USA: US spot prod diffs steady at close in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot prod diffs steady at close in modest trade.

text.p: U.S. spot product differentials were nearly flat with the previous day's levels at the NYMEX close Tuesday in very thin market trade, according to players.
"There's no scheduling deadlines (on the Colonial Pipeline), we're just about between months and the NYMEX is moving on API expectations," one trader said. "The market is catatonic."
However, outright heating oil prices rallied more than 1.00 cent on the back of the April NYMEX rally, which has held onto its early session strength.

U.S. Gulf conventional unleaded M1 gasoline for tenth cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline was talked between about 3.50 and 3.60 cents under the screen, slightly weaker than late Monday levels, although traders saw no barrels changing hands.
New York Harbor (NYH) gasoline diffs were little changed, with prompt M4 barrels hovering around 5.75 cents under the screen, and the spring-grade M2 gasoline at abpit 2.00 cents under the print.
NYH prompt No. 2 oil was offered at even with the NYMEX, while Gulf barrels for the 10th cycle were talked at 2.00 cents under.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
